game:gamemechanicinfo-electricalprogress:
Electricity: ElectricalProgressive Mod
The mod adds electrical energy, electrical appliances, devices, weapons, and armor to the game. All of this helps to simplify (or not) survival in the game world, reduce routine, and diversify the gameplay.

Basics
The law of conservation of energy states that energy cannot be created or destroyed. Energy only transforms from one form to another or transfers from one body to another. The same applies in-game.

The primary source of mechanical energy is windmills. Using generators, mechanical energy can be converted into electrical energy. To do this, transmit torque from the mill to the generator shaft using a shaft and/or gear. After that, the generator will start producing electricity.

Electrical energy can be transmitted via cables to consumers. Simply place cables block by block in the desired direction. Up to 4 cables can be placed on each block face, pointing in different directions. This allows cables to be routed in any direction and electrical circuits to be branched. Cables must be connected to the iron plate of an electrical device for it to operate. Electrical devices, metal blocks, and through-wall connectors can also conduct current.

Since the wind does not always blow at full strength, generator output may be insufficient to power all electrical devices. To prevent this, connect your electrical circuit to an accumulator (or multiple). They will continuously store electrical energy and release it into the circuit to power devices at any time, even when there is no wind.

To save energy, some devices must be disconnected from the circuit when not in use. For this purpose, use a manual switch. Install it on a section of the circuit where quick power disconnection is needed.

For some devices that still require mechanical energy to operate, a motor will be needed. It converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. Connect it to the device with a shaft. When turned on, the motor will strive to deliver maximum power to the shaft, so ensure the circuit has sufficient energy.

Electricity: Motors and Generators
Motors and generators in the mod allow conversion of electrical energy into mechanical energy and vice versa. To do this, connect cables and attach a shaft to them.

Game Mechanics Features
Motors and generators closely mimic the behavior of real-life devices. As an example, DC machines were used. Therefore, to better understand how to use them and in what situations, it is necessary to understand the principles they operate on.
All rotating mechanisms in the game, including shafts and gears, have two basic parameters: torque and resistance. Torque characterizes the force with which a mechanism rotates a shaft, and resistance characterizes friction forces and losses that may occur during operation. The torque of shafts and gears is zero. The game engine sums all torques and calculates shaft speed and its acceleration/deceleration. If the torque is greater than the resistance, the shaft speed will increase. If the opposite is true, it will decrease. In this process, both parameters change according to specific laws. Usually, resistance increases with speed.

Generators
In the mod, generators have the following additional parameters:
I_max – maximum energy output value;
speed_max – maximum rated rotation speed;
resistance_factor – multiplier for resistance torque;
resistance_load – constant component of resistance torque (achieved at I_max).

Generator energy output depends only on shaft speed and is calculated proportionally to shaft speed. When speed_max is exceeded, output equals power = I_max.
Resistance torque initially increases linearly, and after exceeding speed_max, it increases quadratically. Also, resistance torque is directly proportional to the electrical circuit load on this generator. Therefore, with no consumption, the generator will create minimal resistance torque.

Motors
In the mod, motors have the following additional parameters:
I_min – minimum energy value required for the motor to start operating;
I_max – maximum energy consumption value;
torque_max – maximum torque;
kpd_max – efficiency;
speed_max – maximum rated rotation speed;
resistance_factor – multiplier for resistance torque.

A motor delivers torque directly proportional to the energy available to it. The motor also accounts for its own efficiency.

The motor's resistance torque is calculated similarly to the generator, only resistance_load is zero.

Electricity: Current Behavior, Voltage
Electric current now flows through conductors obeying the laws of physics. Some may need to reopen their physics textbooks!

New Behavior Features
Electric current moves through conductors as packets of energy, except in instant mode. Energy packets travel along the shortest path from power sources to consumers. Also, cables and devices now have their own electrical conductor parameters: resistivity (depends on material), cross-sectional area, maximum current (exceeding risks burning), maximum voltage. Current value is calculated using Ohm's law for a circuit section, for all energy packets passing through that face/block at the moment. The direction of energy movement is also considered: if energy moves in opposite directions, their corresponding currents are subtracted algebraically (a consequence of Kirchhoff's first law). To prevent cables from burning out, they can be thickened. To do this, hold a cable of the same type as the one already placed and click on it while holding Shift. This increases the current margin in the circuit. However, note that losses in the conductor are calculated using Joule's law. Increasing the passing current significantly increases energy losses. For long-distance energy transmission, voltage can be increased, or accumulators can be used as buffer storage.

Voltages
Now, different devices require not only different amounts of energy but also different voltages. Exceeding the voltage for a device/cable risks burning it. Voltage can be stepped up or down using a transformer – it works in both directions. Therefore, be careful when connecting wires of different voltages! Higher voltage allows more energy to be transmitted through wires.

Interaction with the Environment
Now, uninsulated cables and metal blocks will damage all entities upon contact. The higher the voltage in the circuit, the more damage they will inflict. Burned devices and cables will also cause damage. Insulated cables and all operating devices are safe to touch.
All cables and devices have a moisture resistance parameter. If there is no moisture resistance, your device/cable risks burning upon contact with rain, snow, hail, and spilled water nearby! Upon contact with lava, they burn, break, and are likely destroyed. Be careful.

block-handbooktext-etermogenerator:
Converts thermal energy into electrical energy! Runs on anything that supports combustion. The higher the combustion temperature of the fuel, the greater the output power. Output power also slightly depends on ambient temperature: the lower the ambient air temperature, the greater the energy output. Does not work by itself – thermoelectric plates must be installed at the back.

Can be automatically loaded with fuel using hoppers.
block-handbooktext-termoplastini:
Thermoelectric plates are used in thermoelectric generators to convert thermal energy into electrical energy. The operating principle is based on the thermoelectric effect where a temperature difference creates an electric voltage between two dissimilar metals. The temperature difference is created by the smoke from burning fuel on one side and ambient air on the other.

Placed behind the thermoelectric generator, up to 10 pieces. Can only be attached to the copper pad of the heat exchanger. Each subsequent section provides a smaller power increase. In total, 10 thermoplates give 100% power to the thermogenerator. Two generators can use the same set of thermoelectric plates.
block-handbooktext-esolargenerator: Converts light into electrical energy! The more sunlight hits the solar panel, the more energy it can produce. Blocks placed above the solar panel will reduce its efficiency. In late autumn and winter, sunlight decreases, leading to reduced efficiency.
